rules.rationale: Retuned 2026-08-21: the original threshold of 12 never fired in 2026-07-24..2026-08-21 — observed atrPct over that period peaked at 2.50%. A threshold outside the observed range provides no protection at all. 4 sits above everything seen so far while staying in a realistic order of magnitude for 1h ETH candles; the evaluator will confirm, retune, or drop this once trades close under the new range.

Seed rule, not evidence-based. Grid trading earns in sideways and downtrending markets and underperforms buy-and-hold in a bull run; laddering into a blow-off top deploys capital at the worst levels. The evaluator will confirm, retune, or drop this once real trades exist.
